notes: All roster features use prior completed games, not end-season/current target roster lists.
Freshman/recruit rank is a pre-college attribute; archived labels are downloaded now, not historical HTTP snapshots.
Availability archives lack report publication timestamps and are excluded from numeric training.

context_selection_provenance.note: Point model selection uses old chronological validation; historical benchmark reuse remains exploratory. Archives without report timestamps are not features.

uncertainty_note: Opening-week nominal 80% coverage remains about 76%; do not present it as fully calibrated.
